decisions.reason: Correctly ties top-level ESM import to the one classic-script combo parse failure killing all 53 entries, explains typert-registry as first-awaited victim with the real culprit one cause level down; no overgeneralization that ESM is invalid everywhere.

Bisects plugin insert rows, reproduces with vm.Script classic-script compile (not node --check), and fully describes ModuleLoader.load({id,factory}), package-name identity, host React via factory require, inject/apply exports.

Explains parent/children-table ownership well, but never states apply ordering is not guaranteed, and its inject form is an array payload rather than the deferred inject(name, () => register(...)) callback that waits for the declaration; treats kind as conditionally registrant-owned.
Combo assembled once at boot, edits/refresh ineffective, full stop/restart with taskkill /PID /T /F and port verification, EADDRINUSE explained as orphaned old process holding the port.

Proposes per-plugin classic-script validation at boot with culprit attribution instead of first-awaited-entry blame, plus a concrete template/checklist covering factory, host React require, inject/apply, deferred slots.inject, and Windows tree-kill restart discipline.

caps.reason: Final advice affirms classic-script bundle, slots.inject channel, and host restart; kind/scope treatment is hedged as schema-dependent/unconfirmed rather than an affirmative contradiction.
